import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0236 {S : Type _} [Fintype S] (a : Π (i : S), ℤ) (f : S → S) (hf : bijection f) : 
  a = a ∘ f := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0236 {S : Type _} [Fintype S] (a : Π (i : S), ℤ) (f : S → S) (hf : bijection f) : 
  a = a ∘ f :=
by
  have hbij : ∀ x : S, f x ∈ S := by
    rw [bijection_def, hf]
    exact λ x, by
      split
      · exact mem_range_self _
      · exact mem_range_self _
  have hinv : ∀ x : S, f (f⁻¹ x) = x := by
    rw [bijection_def, hf]
    exact λ x, by
      split
      · exact eq_self_of_idempotent (f x)
      · exact eq_self_of_idempotent (f x)
  have hcomp : ∀ x : S, (a ∘ f) x = a (f x) := by
    simp only [function.comp_app]
  have hinv_app : ∀ x : S, (f ∘ f⁻¹) x = x := by
    simp only [function.comp_app, hinv]
  have hinv_id : f ∘ f⁻¹ = id := by
    ext
    exact hinv_app
  have h_id : id = id := by
    refl
  have h_same : ∀ x : S, a x = a (f (f⁻¹ x)) := by
    simp only [hcomp, hinv_app]
  have h_reindex : a = a ∘ f := by
    ext x
    rw [h_same x, hinv_id x]
    exact h_id
  exact h_reindex
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0236 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0236 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0236

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0236
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0236
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
